records.text: Owens says Tucker Carlson investigated gold sellers’ misleading sales tactics and excessive markups and then founded Battalion Metals.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: My friend Tucker Carlson investigated the industry and was shocked to discover that the biggest names in the business were robbing customers with misleading sales tactics, confusing markups, and patriotic branding to win trust. ...
